parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with a narrow QRS and a deep S wave with a tall, symmetric T wave in V2-V3, which is a benign early-repolarization / high-voltage pattern. The ST segments are concave, with no convex ST elevation, no reciprocal ST depression and no pathologic Q waves, so STEMI criteria are not met even though the team read it as acute STEMI.
